description: Approved-asset allowlist for the LPC sprite pipeline. The composer refuses to ingest any source path not covered here, so only vetted parts ever reach a shipped sprite. NOTE: this gates WHICH assets are composed; the per-asset license/attribution vetting (CC-BY / OGA-BY / CC0 vs ShareAlike) is tracked separately under the 'legally safe to ship' task and documented in README.md.

equipmentAllowlist.note: The committed equipment overlays in public/game/lpc are the approved equipment set. Their canonical list lives in public/game/lpc/generated_manifest.json (every entry's 'file' is an approved overlay). The composer treats that manifest as the equipment allowlist in --verify mode.
